difficulty_reason: Addendum to the Zariski-main-theorem-style lemma (quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally quasi-finite monomorphism factors through a finite Y-space): if f is in addition locally of finite presentation, the factorization X -> T -> Y can have T finite AND of finite presentation over Y. The retained proof: write the existing finite T as a filtered limit lim T_i of finite, finitely presented Y-spaces with closed transition immersions (Limits of Spaces, finite-in-finite-and-finite-presentation); the open X subset T descends to an open U_i of some T_i (descend-opens); for large i the map X -> U_i is an isomorphism (finite-type-eventually-closed); replacing T by T_i finishes. Retained author proof at lines 7814-7827.
